mapper.sql: SELECT student.id, student.name, student.birthday, student.login_id, student.login_pass, student.status FROM students student
mapper.select: WHERE student.status = 'ACT' ORDER BY student.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO students (name, birthday, login_id, login_pass) VALUES (#{name}, #{birthday}, #{loginId}, #{loginPass})
mapper.update: UPDATE students SET name = #{name}, birthday = #{birthday}, login_id = #{loginId}, login_pass = #{loginPass} WHERE id = #{id}
